name: plugin.trustgraph_ontology_governor
description: TrustGraph ontology governor plugin providing SHACL-AF subject-IRI PolicyFilter, OntologyRAG small-schema bypass and cycle-safe subClassOf validation, PROV-O dual named-graph explainability, and Laya entropy decision scoring
author: Brain Harness Authors

entrypoints.name: tg_evaluate_shacl_policy
entrypoints.description: Evaluate SHACL-AF subject-IRI policies in sh:order precedence with first-match-wins semantics and explicit open-mode fallback

parameters.name: triples
parameters.description: List of triple dictionaries containing s, p, and o keys

parameters.name: policies
parameters.description: Optional list of SHACL-AF sh:NodeShape policy rule dictionaries

parameters.name: subject_attributes
parameters.description: Mapping from subject IRI to attribute/type metadata for policy evaluation

entrypoints.name: tg_validate_ontology_triples
entrypoints.description: Validate extracted relationship and attribute triples using OntologySelector bypass thresholds and cycle-safe subClassOf closure

parameters.name: ontology
parameters.description: Ontology dictionary with classes, object_properties, and datatype_properties

parameters.name: triples
parameters.description: Extracted relationship or attribute triple dictionaries

parameters.name: bypass_selector_below
parameters.description: Bypass vector selector when total ontology elements fall below this threshold (default 5)

parameters.name: top_k
parameters.description: Selector top-k parameter preserved for OntologySelector parity

parameters.name: similarity_threshold
parameters.description: Selector cosine similarity threshold (default 0.3)

entrypoints.name: tg_build_provenance_trace
entrypoints.description: Build dual named-graph PROV-O extraction lineage (urn:graph:source) and 5-stage query explainability traces (urn:graph:retrieval)

parameters.name: question_id
parameters.description: Unique query identifier anchoring urn:trustgraph:question and stage URIs

parameters.name: query_text
parameters.description: Natural language query string recorded on the question node

parameters.name: document_id
parameters.description: Optional source document ID emitted under https://trustgraph.ai/doc/ into urn:graph:source

parameters.name: extraction_triples
parameters.description: Optional source extraction triples scoped to urn:graph:source

parameters.name: stage_details
parameters.description: Optional comments mapped by explainability stage name

parameters.name: prompt_tokens
parameters.description: Prompt token count attached to synthesis PROV-O triples

parameters.name: completion_tokens
parameters.description: Completion token count attached to synthesis PROV-O triples

parameters.name: total_tokens
parameters.description: Optional explicit total token override

entrypoints.name: tg_score_laya_decision
entrypoints.description: Score Laya ONNX routing decisions with clamped temperature calibration, normalized Shannon entropy confidence, and head-token option budgeting

parameters.name: question_type
parameters.description: Laya decision type: choice, score, or noul

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Candidate option labels evaluated by Laya

parameters.name: logits_or_probs
parameters.description: Raw model logits or pre-normalized option probabilities

parameters.name: temperature
parameters.description: Sampling temperature safely clamped to [0.5, 5.0] with non-finite fallback to 1.0

parameters.name: question_tokens
parameters.description: Question prefix token count

parameters.name: option_tokens_each
parameters.description: Estimated tokens per option entry

parameters.name: probs_already_normalized
parameters.description: Treat input array as simplex probabilities rather than raw logits

parameters.name: temp_buckets
parameters.description: Bucket quantization granularity (default 10)
